raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Pronunciation fixes found while making the 「24GB 显卡跑 60GB 视频模型」 explainer video (2026-10-19). Every entry was measured with `pron_check.py` (Xiaoxiao voice + Whisper):

| Written | Spoken | Before (Whisper) → after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| checkpoint | check point | ChatPoint in every carrier → **checkpoint** |
| OOM | O O M | Om (read as a word) → **OOM** |
| comfy-kitchen | Comfy Kitchen | a bare *kitchen* → Tichen in every spelling; the pair passes |
| fa (FlashAttention backend) | F A | read as a syllable in context (Fall / 发 / 法 / Ford) → **FA** |

Rewords added to the table:
- `int mm` → 「PyTorch 自带的 INT8 矩阵乘接口」
- `INT32` → 「32 位整数累加」

The 行 note now also covers 「按行动态量化」: there 行 sits before 动 and forms 行动, so the text should be written 「逐行做动态量化」.

## pron_check fix

The carrier now reads the term's full spoken form with `patterns` applied (`to_spoken`, not just `spoken_token`). Before this, `24GB` was synthesized raw and reported as a FAIL (heard `24G`), even though the engine sends `24 G B`, which passes. Verified: `24 G B` / `60 G B` / `32 G B` all come back OK.

## Worker-dispatch lessons

`references/worker-dispatch.md` gains a list of lessons to append to every dispatch:
- no whole-frame camera drift;
- SVG `transformOrigin` on both sides of a `fromTo` (to-side only shifted an axis by 480px);
- how to chain short video clips, and why the `nested_media_start_basis_ambiguous` lint warning is expected;
- `check_frames` reports "missing follow strip" on whichever frame is currently the highest-numbered, so workers should ignore it mid-run;
- excerpt line ranges are fixed upstream, never paraphrased.

## Tests

- `uvx pytest tests/test_explainer_pronounce.py`: 11 passed (new `test_terms_from_the_24gb_video`).
- pre-commit: clean.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

 Not covered on purpose, because both readings are common: 这行 / 那行 (那行吧 = xíng), 此行, 同行, 单行, 上行 / 下行, 各行.
-Write 这一行 / 同一行 / 那一行 instead and the rule applies. One false positive remains: 一行三人 (a party of three)
+Write 这一行 / 同一行 / 那一行 instead and the rule applies. The guard words also bite the writer: 「按行动态量化」
+puts 行 before 动, so the rule leaves it (行动 = xíng dòng) and the voice may read it that way. Write 「逐行做动态量化」
+(24GB video, 2026-10-19). One false positive remains: 一行三人 (a party of three)
 becomes yì háng. It is very rare in technical narration; reword it if it ever appears.
 
 **Measuring a polyphone** (any character, e.g. 长 常/肠 vs 掌/涨, 重 众/仲 vs 虫/崇):

@@ -48,5 +48,23 @@ share a stage (same diagram before/after, two code frames) on the same worker.
   Reply with one line per file: path + one-sentence summary.
 ```
 
+Append these lessons to every dispatch, after the template above. Each one cost a fix and a re-render in an
+earlier film. The project's `dispatch.py` keeps the full list.
+
+- No whole-frame camera drift: never tween scale/x/y on a frame-wide wrapper (no slow push-in). Workers kept
+  adding `fromTo('#fNN-cam', {scale:1}, {scale:1.01x})`; grep for `-cam` after a wave.
+- On SVG elements, give `transformOrigin` on **both** sides of a `fromTo`. Set only on the "to" side, it trips
+  GSAP's smoothOrigin and shifted an axis by 480px (24GB video).
+- Real video clips: `<video class="clip" muted playsinline data-media-start="0" data-track-index="N">`. When the
+  clip is shorter than the frame, chain copies back to back (each `data-duration` ≤ the clip length, the last one
+  trimmed to the frame end). `data-start` inside a frame is frame-local; `hf lint`'s
+  `nested_media_start_basis_ambiguous` warning on chained copies is expected.
+- `check_frames.mjs` treats the highest-numbered frame on disk as the last frame, so mid-run it reports "missing
+  follow strip" on whatever frame is newest. Tell workers to ignore it unless they hold the real last frame.
+- Excerpt line ranges come from the orchestrator. If a Scene line names a code line that is not in the packet's
+  excerpt, the worker should report it, not paraphrase. The fix is upstream: correct the range in `frames.py`
+  and regenerate the packet. In the 24GB video, a range was off by one and dropped the `copy_` line the narration
+  was about.
+
 Retry (once per frame): SendMessage to the same worker with the exact validator/lint finding and the
 check command; ask it to change only what the finding names.
